comments.body: I found no concrete defect, but I cannot establish safety from what I can see, so a human needs to look at this. The core of the change is new tensor-parallel code: NCCL collectives, CUDA-graph capture of all-reduce, and worker subprocess lifecycle. The only tests that cover it are the CPU gloo tests; the GPU tests (tests/test_tp_gpu.py) are skipped here for lack of two CUDA devices. Coverage also reports most changed lines in dist.py, engine.py (launch_tp, worker_loop, _materialize), weights.py and engine_core.py as not executed in the measured run. The paths I could not check by reading are: deadlock or ordering between the driver's broadcasts and the workers' forward when a step fails on the driver, graph replay with collectives, int8 quantization combined with tensor parallelism (the tiny path skips quantization), and the behavior of `ModelConfig.head_dim` becoming a dataclass field for the MLA and MoE configs. I did not run a probe, so there is no evidence for approve.

This PR adds about 800 lines of Spark transformation code in silver.py, gold.py and report.py, plus the new table_path routing in config.py. No test executes any of it; the coverage data shows every new line as unexecuted. The existing 9 tests only cover landing and redaction. The riskiest parts are the three worker-log timestamp formats and their timezone handling, the join of the series gpu_model seed to the gpu_label seed for pricing, the FlashBoot hit threshold, and the cost formulas. Correctness depends on the seed CSVs, which are not shown, and on real bronze data, which I cannot see. A probe on the pure helpers (fmt, table_path) would not cover the Spark logic, where the risk lies. A human should run `make all` on real data and spot-check the gold output.

import importlib.util, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

def test_flags_exist_in_cli(monkeypatch):
    p = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'deploy' / 'runpod' / 'main.py'
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('rp_main', p)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    for k, v in {'PREFIX_CACHING': '1', 'QUANTIZATION': 'int8', 'TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE': '2'}.items():
        monkeypatch.setenv(k, v)
    cmd = mod.serve_command('/models/m')
    flags = [c for c in cmd if c.startswith('--')]
    helptext = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pagedserve.cli', 'serve', '--help'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    missing = [f for f in flags if f not in helptext]
    assert not missing, missing

import importlib.util, re
from pathlib import Path

def test_health_route_and_flags():
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    app_src = (root / 'pagedserve' / 'server' / 'app.py').read_text()
    assert re.search(r'["\']/health["\']', app_src), 'server has no /health route'
    cli_src = (root / 'pagedserve' / 'cli.py').read_text()
    for f in ['--enable-cuda-graphs', '--enable-prefix-caching', '--served-model-name', '--quantization', '--tensor-parallel-size', '--attn-backend', '--block-size', '--max-model-len', '--max-num-seqs', '--host', '--port', '--dtype', '--device', '--model']:
        assert f'"{f}"' in cli_src or f"'{f}'" in cli_src, f
    p = root / 'deploy' / 'runpod' / 'main.py'
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('rp_main2', p)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    cmd = mod.serve_command('/m')
    assert cmd[cmd.index('--port') + 1] == str(mod.PORT)

probes.source:
import torch
try:
    from tests.test_engine import make_engine
except ImportError:
    from test_engine import make_engine
from pagedserve.llm import LLM
from pagedserve.sched.request import SamplingParams


def test_chunked_tight_cache_preempt_prefix():
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(5)
    shared = torch.randint(2, 100, (8,), generator=g).tolist()
    ps = [shared + torch.randint(2, 100, (n,), generator=g).tolist() for n in (3, 11, 6, 14, 2, 9)]
    sp = SamplingParams.greedy(10, ignore_eos=True)
    ref = LLM.from_engine(make_engine('paged_torch')).generate(ps, sp)
    for prefix in (False, True):
        eng = make_engine('paged_torch', num_blocks=14, block_size=4, max_batched=6,
                          enable_chunked_prefill=True, enable_prefix_caching=prefix)
        res = LLM.from_engine(eng).generate(ps, sp)
        assert [r.output_token_ids for r in res] == [r.output_token_ids for r in ref]
        assert all(s.num_tokens <= 6 or s.num_decode_tokens > 6 for s in eng.stats)
        assert eng.block_manager.num_free_blocks == eng.block_manager.num_blocks
